# ggpaver (Still in Development)

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of `ggpaver` is to facilitate the use of [pavement plots](https://planspace.org/20260908-pavement_plots/) in R as a `ggplot2` extension. Pavement plots present univariate continuous data as tiles ranging between the minimal and maximal values, with each tile representing an equal share of the data. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of `ggpaver` from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("git-dwilliams/ggpaver")
```

## Example
```{r}
#| label: example
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpaver)

ggplot(diamonds, aes(x = price, y = cut)) +
  geom_pavement(bins = 16) +
  labs(
    title = "A Pavement Plot of Diamond Price (USD) by Cut",
    subtitle = "Each Tile Represents an Equal Share of its Group's Data"
  )
```

## Original Implementation in Python
Check out Aaron Schumacher's original (and much more mature) [implementation in Python](https://github.com/ajschumacher/pavement/):
```sh
pip install pavement
```
